xml_content: yang kha cig na re me dang du ba rgyu 'bras su nges pa ni du ba me las skye bzhin par mthong pa'i tshad ma cig nyid kyis nges pa yin no zhes zer ba yang Possibly gNyal zhig (ID:3887), as a similar theory is cited in Rigs gter rang 'grel (ID:5564) [CXRAK3IW] VI 158,24 (kha cig me las du ba skye ba mngon sum gyis grub pas rgyu 'bras sgrub byed gzhan mi dgos so zhes zer ba), and attributed to "slob dpon gnyal pa la sogs pa" (ID:3887) in Rigs gter nyi ma [3C855HMK] 145,13. mi rigs te | dang po gnyi' ga ma dmigs pa las rgyu dmigs pa'i rjes su 'bras bu dmigs pa'i tshad ma gsuM med na skye bar mi 'grub pa'i phyir ro ||||
